findings.problem: The hint includes the Spanish answer itself (un montón de), so there is nothing to recall, and without it 'pile' could also be la pila or la montaña.
findings.fix: hint: a heap of things; in casual speech also means 'a ton of'

back.es: the pile, the heap; casually, a lot (un montón de = a lot of)
back.example: I have a ton of work today.

note: Montón really does come from monte (mountain), so the trick is accurate as well as easy to remember.
